name: dkg-claude-code-memory
description: MCP server for persistent, verifiable Working Memory on OriginTrail DKG v10

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const f='dist/index.js'; const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); if(!c.startsWith('#!')) fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run build && npm audit --production

author: drMurlly
